constraints.primaryEvidence: upstream issue plus local host conformance failure
constraints.strategy: retain the last proven version and re-run host conformance before removing the block
constraints.versionGate: apply only when the installed version exactly matches an affected entry
constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days; do not silently extend stale evidence
constraints.sunsetWhen: an upstream release closes the issue and passes agentic-kit's host-neutral hook and lifecycle conformance suite

constraints.primaryEvidence: upstream issue plus local capability evidence
constraints.strategy: keep agentic-kit detection read-only and treat registration, health, reachability, and authorization as separate facts
constraints.versionGate: treat every 3.x version as observation-only until independently verified
constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days; do not silently extend stale evidence
constraints.sunsetWhen: upstream exposes the required evidence and agentic-kit verifies it against a released artifact

constraints.primaryEvidence: upstream issue, v3.14.0 release receipt, and local external-provider conformance
constraints.strategy: retain honest external-provider attribution and use the released declarative provider contract only after local conformance
constraints.versionGate: applies only to the listed pre-3.14 releases; 3.14.0 requires its own conformance rather than inheriting closure
constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days; do not silently extend stale evidence
constraints.sunsetWhen: v3.14.0 or later passes the live external-provider participant and advisor conformance tests

constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days and on every Agentic-QE release
